title: 第一卷 第11章 首次炼丹第一卷 第12章 暴利
slug: 我为族长当缔造诸天万界之禁忌家族
content_zh:
黄级上品——赤焰炼丹炉：
采用火山赤铁炼制而成，适合炼制一至二阶丹药，价格一百枚下品灵晶。
黄级极品——寒冰炼丹炉：
采用深海寒铁炼制而成，擅长炼制寒性丹药，价格三百枚下品灵晶。
玄级中品——万象炼丹炉：
采用多种灵材炼制而成，可兼容多种属性丹药，成丹率高，价格一千二百枚下品灵晶。
顾天阳的目光最终落在了玄级中品的万象炼丹炉上。
这尊炼丹炉通体呈暗金色，炉身雕刻着繁复的纹路，隐隐有流光转动。
它不仅兼容多种属性，成丹率高，足以支撑他炼制出更高品级的丹药，完全符合他现在的需求。
“就这尊万象炼丹炉了。”
顾天阳说道。
侍女眼中闪过一丝惊讶，玄级中品的炼丹炉价格不菲，需要一千二百枚下品灵晶。
即便是城内的那些大家族，拿出这么多的灵晶也会肉疼。
她没想到眼前这位看似普通的公子，竟然如此阔绰。
“公子，这尊万象炼丹炉价格是一千二百枚下品灵晶，您确定要购买吗？”
侍女再次确认道。
顾天阳点头，心念一动。
一千二百枚下品灵晶便出现在了面前，堆成了一小堆，散发出浓郁的灵气波动。
然后，就把炼丹炉收了起来。
至此，他这次出来办的目的都完成了。

不仅捡漏般的带回了三位身负体质的姑娘，还购买到了炼丹所需的灵药和炼丹炉，可谓是收获满满。
“走吧，我们回府。”
顾天阳对身旁的三位姑娘说道。
三人点点头，乖巧地跟在顾天阳身后，朝着顾家的方向走去。
离开万宝阁后。
顾天阳走在最前方，步伐沉稳，同时注意是否有人跟踪他们。
毕竟方才在万宝阁的花费很大。
一千五百枚下品灵晶采购灵药，一千二百枚下品灵晶购入万象炼丹炉。
再加上之前为三女赎身的三百枚下品灵晶，前后共计花了三千枚下品灵晶。
这笔数目，即便是青云城的四大家族，也得好好的掂量掂量。
更何况他此刻伪装的只是一个聚气境五层的普通修士。
树大招风，难免会引起一些不怀好意之人的窥探。
content_en:
Yellow-level top grade——Red Flame Alchemy Furnace:
Made from volcanic hematite, it is suitable for refining first- to second-level elixirs and costs one hundred low-grade spiritual crystals.
The best yellow-level product - Ice Alchemy Furnace:
It is made from deep sea cold iron and is good at refining cold elixirs. It costs 300 low-grade spiritual crystals.
Xuan-level middle-grade—Wanxiang Alchemy Furnace:
It is refined from a variety of spiritual materials and is compatible with elixirs of various attributes. It has a high elixir-forming rate and costs 1,200 low-grade spiritual crystals.
Gu Tianyang's eyes finally fell on the Xuan-level mid-grade Vientiane Alchemy Furnace.
This alchemy furnace is dark golden in color, with complex patterns carved on the furnace body, and there is a faint flowing light.
It is not only compatible with a variety of attributes, but also has a high elixir-forming rate, which is enough to support him in refining higher-grade elixirs, which fully meets his current needs.
"This is the all-encompassing alchemy furnace."
Gu Tianyang said.
A trace of surprise flashed in the maid's eyes. A mid-level Xuan-level alchemy furnace is expensive and requires 1,200 low-level spiritual crystals.
Even the big families in the city would feel pain if they took out so many spiritual crystals.
She didn't expect that the seemingly ordinary young man in front of her could be so wealthy.
"Sir, the price of this Vientiane Alchemy Furnace is 1,200 low-grade spiritual crystals. Are you sure you want to buy it?"
The maid confirmed again.
Gu Tianyang nodded with a thought in his mind.
Twelve hundred low-grade spiritual crystals appeared in front of them, piled into a small pile, emitting strong spiritual energy fluctuations.
Then, he put away the alchemy furnace.
At this point, the purpose of what he came out to do this time has been completed.
Not only did he bring back three girls with special constitutions, but he also purchased the elixirs and alchemy furnaces needed to make alchemy, which can be said to be a full harvest.
"Let's go back home."
Gu Tianyang said to the three girls beside him.
The three of them nodded and followed Gu Tianyang obediently towards the Gu family.
After leaving Wanbao Pavilion.
Gu Tianyang walked at the front with a steady pace, while paying attention to whether anyone was following them.
After all, I just spent a lot of money in Wanbao Pavilion.
One thousand five hundred low-grade spiritual crystals were used to purchase elixirs, and one thousand two hundred low-grade spiritual crystals were used to purchase the Vientiane Alchemy Furnace.
In addition to the 300 low-grade spiritual crystals used to redeem the lives of the three women, a total of 3,000 low-grade spiritual crystals were spent.
Even the four major families in Qingyun City have to weigh this amount carefully.
What's more, he is pretending to be just an ordinary monk at the fifth level of the Qi Gathering Realm.
A big tree attracts the wind, which will inevitably attract the prying eyes of some malicious people.
